Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent overhead pixel-art boss sprite sheet for DEAD ZONE. Design THE WARDEN, Fort Ashgrove's last sentry, a colossal undead military siege mutant 3.5 times larger than normal bosses. Match the existing boss-lineup reference visible in conversation: gritty dense pixel clusters, charcoal dark outlines, muted diseased green flesh, textured armor, top-left highlights. DISTINCT from Juggernaut: hugely broad asymmetric bunker-like back armored with bolted dark olive military steel and weathered concrete slabs with embedded bent rebar, broken restraint chains draped across back, massive bare knuckled forearms wrapped in rusty metal braces, tiny bald scarred forward head, torn burgundy remnants of military officer coat, heavy black boots. Restrained hot amber-orange fissures between armor plates (small accents, NOT flames). Intimidating fortress silhouette readable at giant game scale. No held weapon: attacks are fists, shoulder charge, ground slam, thrown rubble.
Camera STRICT 90degree vertically overhead showing crown shoulders TOPS of armor, facing RIGHT/EAST in every frame. Do not make front-view or upright side-view character portraits. Orthographic, same camera as the existing bosses. Square highresolution image, EXACT FOUR columns FOUR rows of equal square cells, 16sprites. Same central torso pivot and body scale in every cell, figure fits central78% of eachcell, ample clear margin on everyedge; no extremities crossing into adjacent cells. Transparent background with actual alpha. No floor, shadows, text, grids, labels, watermark or decorative frame.

Row2: heavywalk rightstep, heavywalk passingalternate, massivefist melee windback, massivefist forwardstrike.

Row4: hit recoil/stunned, death knees buckle, death falling onto side, dead giant body fully collapsed viewed from overhead facingeast.

Clear distinct drawn poses and steppingfeet. Natural chunky painted pixel detail suitable for384px animation frames at large zoom, no smooth3D render.
